Mapping from Vaccine products (illustrative PreQual-style codes) to National schedule antigen-dose codes (illustrative, Lao PDR)

Source CodeRelationshipTarget CodeComment
vp-hepb-peds-monovalent (Hepatitis B vaccine, paediatric, monovalent)is equivalent toLAO-EPI-HEPB-BD (Hepatitis B birth dose)Added from the nurse's adjudication at Vientiane District Health Center, 2025-11-25: a monovalent paediatric Hep B dose given within 24 hours of birth counts as the schedule's birth dose.
vp-bcg-freeze-dried (BCG vaccine, freeze-dried)is equivalent toLAO-EPI-BCG (BCG)
vp-pentavalent-liquid (DTP-HepB-Hib (pentavalent), liquid)is equivalent toLAO-EPI-PENTA-1 (Pentavalent (DTP-HepB-Hib), dose 1)
vp-bopv-drops (Bivalent oral polio vaccine (bOPV), drops)is equivalent toLAO-EPI-OPV-1 (bOPV, dose 1)
vp-pcv-13-dose (Pneumococcal conjugate vaccine (PCV))is equivalent toLAO-EPI-PCV-1 (PCV, dose 1)
vp-mr-freeze-dried (Measles-rubella vaccine, freeze-dried)is equivalent toLAO-EPI-MR-1 (Measles-rubella, dose 1)

name: TrustDemoProductToLaoEpi
title: J3 map: vaccine product to national schedule dose
description: The national map the clinic EHR uses in J3 to add the schedule code beside the issuer's product code, which it never replaces. The Hep B product had no entry until Nurse Chanthasone confirmed its equivalence on 2025-11-25 (see TrustDemoJ3Adjudication); her decision is recorded here so the next clinic need not make it again.
